"version": "1",
"text": "This look is a perfect balance of sophisticated warmth and festive polish, tailored just for your New Year's restaurant celebration. The grey printed blazer defines your waist with a peplum cut that flatters your X-figure, while the dark chocolate suede over-the-knee boots add height and rich texture against the frosty season. Anchored by deep burgundy and burnt orange tones from the coat and bag, this palette feels both traditional for the holiday and strikingly modern, carrying you effortlessly from a quiet dinner to a lively toast.",
"how_to_wear": [
"wear the grey blazer over the cream turtleneck sweater to keep the neckline clean and elongated",
"let the velvet belt of the coat cinch your waist before layering the peplum-blazer on top for a structured silhouette"
],

"about_items": [
{n: "#54·31", text: "This grey printed blazer is a double-breasted piece with a peplum hem that skims your waist and flares gently over the hips, creating structure without adding bulk."},
{n: "#55·25", text: "These dark beige merino wool trousers offer a clean, straight leg silhouette that balances the volume of your top and extends your line down to your boots."},
{n: "#498·09", text: "The over-the-knee boots are crafted in soft chocolate suede with a sleek pointed toe and a stiletto heel that elevates your posture for long hours at a table."},
{n: "#374·14", text: "This blue and gold embroidered headband brings a delicate touch of floral elegance, catching the light subtly as you move through your evening."},
{n: "#279·04", text: "The burgundy leather belt features polished gold-toned hardware that mirrors the metallic accents in your jewelry for a seamless finish."},
{n: "#61·20", text: "This glossy red crocodile-embossed crossbody bag holds all essentials securely, its bright hue providing a festive focal point against your neutral tones."},
{n: "#287·21", text: "The dark terracotta coat is designed with velvet lapels and an integrated velvet belt that wraps around your waist, adding rich contrast and warmth to the ensemble."}
]
